description_expanded: Description Description 30A Pet Friendly Beach house rental, Georgia Peach at the Beach, located in Seacrest Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a pet friendly 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. GOLF CART INCLUDED AND PET FRIENDLY, SLEEPS 18 Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! FEATURES * Pet Friendly! * 4 Bedroom Beach House - 30A * Large Screened In Porch * Walk or Bike Everywhere * Large Living Area w/Queen Sleeper * Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * Master Bedroom w/King Bed * Master Bedroom Enjoys a Private Balcony & Outdoor Shower * 2nd Bedroom w/King Bed * 3rd Bedroom w/King Bed * 4th Bedroom w/2 Bunks (Twin XL over Queen w/Full Trundle) - Slps 10 * Full Size Washer/Dryer * Outdoor Shower * EV Charging Station * FREE Wi-Fi * Seacrest Beach - Neighboring Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach * Sleeps 18 30A Beach Access Points About 30A Magnolia Cottages by the Sea - Seacrest, FloridaMagnolia Cottages by the Sea, nestled along the renowned 30A, stands out as a cherished family retreat for those seeking an unforgettable vacation experience. Situated in the scenic Seacrest Beach, Florida, this new section of Magnolia Cottages introduces a perfect blend of coastal living and modern amenities. One of its prime features is the convenient Beach Access at Gulf Lakes, providing guests with easy and direct entry to the pristine shores that have made 30A famous. Beyond the sun-kissed beaches, a resort-style pool awaits, nestled seamlessly within the natural wooded beauty of the community. Here, guests find solace after a day of coastal adventures, immersing themselves in the serene surroundings that define the allure of Magnolia Cottages. The community's commitment to preserving its natural charm enhances the overall appeal, creating an atmosphere that invites relaxation and rejuvenation. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea promises an idyllic escape where families can forge lasting memories against the backdrop of this picturesque coastal haven. With its enticing Beach Access, resort-style pool, and the captivating natural setting, Magnolia Cottages emerges as the ideal accommodation for your next family beach vacation. This is not just a place to stay; it's a destination that encapsulates the essence of seaside living and offers an unparalleled retreat for those who appreciate the beauty of both land and sea. Community HighlightsResort Style Pool with Plenty of SeatingBeach Access - Gulf LakesNatural Preserve Feel with Plenty of ShadeWalk or Bike to Rosemary and Alys Beach1 Mile to The Big Chill INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS***We welcome well trained non-shedding dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. This includes emotional support animals. Read less

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
